# dsh-jailbreak-workflow

> Visual soft-workflow plugin (`@minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow`) for DeepSeek Harness (`0.2.x`): design step graphs on a canvas, compile them into a single plan prompt, and let the session model execute branches, loops, and bundled Skills.

## Documentation
- [README.md](./README.md): Primary Chinese documentation with installation, step-by-step usage tutorial, canvas previews, features, and FAQ.
- [README.en.md](./README.en.md): Complete English documentation.

## Installation
- Web (Node.js 22+): `dsh plugin --profile web add @minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow && dsh web`
- Desktop: Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin → `@minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow` → restart DeepSeek Harness.

## Companion Workflow Repository (`Minglink/dsh-workflows`)
- Repository: https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-workflows
- `破甲制作 v3` (`workflows/破甲制作.wflite.zip`): 10-stage, 27-node, 69-edge multi-loop LLM safety & vulnerability evaluation pipeline grounded in 90+ arXiv 2024–2026 papers, with `pass / fail_prompt / fail_surface` self-healing routing and `jailbreak-research` skill.
- `破甲炼化 v2` (`workflows/破甲炼化.wflite.zip`): 8-stage, 22-node, 41-edge prompt refinery implementing WildTeaming `Mine→Compose` crossover, continuous-score verification, and closed-loop `transfer_back.md` ingestion with `jb-distillery` skill.
- `pojia-fullflow v1` (`workflows/pojia-fullflow.wflite.zip`): 10-stage, 20-node, 32-edge reverse-engineering workflow for `dsh-pojia-toolkit`.

## Key Concepts
- Soft workflow: canvas graph compiles into a structured plan prompt executed by the current DeepSeek Harness session model (no external execution engine required).
- `.wflite.zip`: portable package bundling `manifest.json`, versioned canvas documents (`versions/*.json`), and optional `skills/`.
- Path variables: `{workflow}` resolves to `~/.dsh/workflow-lite/assets/<workflow-name>/`; `{instance}` resolves to `.workflow-lite/runs/<instance>/out`.
